bullet: Unknown conversation, bad id, no key (`F06.not-found-auth`).
script:
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$QA_UNKNOWN/events/search" --expect 404 \
  --check detail contains 'Conversation not found' --save F06.not-found-auth/search-404
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$QA_UNKNOWN/events/count" --expect 404
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$QA_UNKNOWN/events/$E2" --expect 404
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$QA_UNKNOWN/events" --json "[\"$E2\"]" --expect 404
control-agent-server api POST "<redacted:session-cookie>/$QA_UNKNOWN/events" --json '{"content":[{"type":"text","text":"QA_F06_X"}]}' --expect 404
control-agent-server api GET <redacted:session-cookie>/qa-not-a-uuid/events/search --expect 422 --check detail.0.loc contains conversation_id
control-agent-server api POST <redacted:session-cookie>/qa-not-a-uuid/events --json '{"content":[{"type":"text","text":"QA_F06_X"}]}' \
  --expect 422 --check detail.0.loc contains conversation_id
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$CID/events/search" --auth none --expect 401 --save F06.not-found-auth/no-key
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$CID/events/count" --auth bad --expect 401
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$CID/events/$E2" --auth none --expect 401
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$CID/events" --json "[\"$E2\"]" --auth bad --expect 401
control-agent-server api POST "<redacted:session-cookie>/$CID/events" --auth none \
  --json '{"content":[{"type":"text","text":"QA_F06_NOAUTH"}]}' --expect 401
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$CID/events/count" --check . eq 5
